title: Maps become isometric city artwork
summary:
Community contributors added three image-making apps, while Enter got a small readability pass.

Map to 3D Isometric Buildings adds a way to turn uploaded or pasted map screenshots into city artwork. Users can describe the location, edit the style prompt, preview the result, and download it.

AI Packaging Designer turns product photos into box, bottle, bag, or can mockups with preset or custom styles. Virtual Makeup Studio applies makeup looks to selfies, with a before-and-after slider for comparison.

The dashboard now labels balances in pollen and makes FAQ, API key, and documentation controls easier to scan.

daily.title: Maps into isometric cities
daily.text: Upload or paste a map screenshot, describe the location, and adjust the style prompt to generate downloadable isometric city artwork.

daily.title: Design packaging mockups
daily.text: Turn a product photo into a box, bottle, bag, or can mockup. Pick a style or write your own description, add brand details, and download the result.

daily.title: Try on AI makeup
daily.text: Upload a selfie and try Natural, Dramatic, K-Beauty, or Vintage makeup—or describe your own look. Compare it with the original using a before-and-after slider.
